title: For each department among Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5),
question: For each department among Mathematics (Course 18) and Chemistry (Course 5), what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any course offered by that department in 2019, the name of the responsible faculty member for that course, the average number of enrolled students for all such courses in that department (considering only courses where the maximum number of enrolled students is greater than 5), the average number of enrolled students in degree-granting subjects (excluding Political Science), the variance of enrolled students in those subjects, the subject with the highest enrollment in that department, and the number of students enrolled in that subject? Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID,
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON tso.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE
  WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%'
    AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry')
    AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL
),
dept_max AS (
  SELECT 
    department, 
    MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled,

  FROM base
  GROUP BY department
),
avg_enrollment AS (
  SELECT 
    department, 
    AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled
  FROM base

  SELECT 
    department,

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH dept_enrollment_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS range_enrolled, VARIANCE(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS var_enrolled FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 1 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), school_max_avg_enrollment AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_enrolled) AS highest_avg_enrolled_per_dept FROM dept_enrollment_stats GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), chemistry_subjects_ranked AS (SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.dense_rank_num_enrolled, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank_num_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') AS inner_cte JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT smax.SCHOOL_NAME, smax.highest_avg_enrolled_per_dept, csr.SUBJECT_TITLE, csr.dense_rank_num_enrolled, csr.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, csr.SCHOOL_NAME AS chemistry_school_name FROM school_max_avg_enrollment AS smax CROSS JOIN chemistry_subjects_ranked AS csr

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptTotalEnrolled AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, MAX(scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20), DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, dte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptTotalEnrolled AS dte JOIN DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS dme ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, inner_cte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_enrolled_students DESC, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10

WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_num_enrolled_students, m.min_academic_year, m.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS c JOIN MathTermStats AS m ON c.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.TERM_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH political_science_subjects AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC), department_units_stats AS (SELECT SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` ON SIS_SUBJECT_CODE.COURSE_NUMBER = SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.COURSE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT <> '18' GROUP BY SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION.DEPARTMENT_NAME), department_school_phone AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ps.geometric_mean_students, ps.total_students, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsp.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.avg_total_units, dus.total_units_range, dus.total_units_variance, dsp.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM (SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students FROM political_science_subjects GROUP BY SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, geometric_mean_students, total_students WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(total_students) > 0) AS ps LEFT JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON ps.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE LEFT JOIN department_units_stats AS dus ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN department_school_phone AS dsp ON dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dsp.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ps.SUBJECT_CODE, ps.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dsp.SCHOOL_NAME, dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), course_counts AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.MASTER_COURSE_NUMBER) AS total_courses FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_code_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(subj_count) AS avg_subject_codes, STDDEV(subj_count) AS stddev_subject_codes, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT cd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS cd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON cd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cd.COURSE, cd.DEPARTMENT) AS course_subjects JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON course_subjects.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, scs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scs.avg_subject_codes, scs.stddev_subject_codes, cc.total_courses FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN subject_code_stats AS scs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scs.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN course_counts AS cc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, scs.avg_subject_codes DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT css.SUBJECT_TITLE, css.TERM_CODE, css.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, css.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, css.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, css.SCHOOL_NAME, css.max_num_enrolled_students, mts.min_academic_year, mts.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS css JOIN MathTermStats AS mts ON css.TERM_CODE = mts.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.max_num_enrolled_students, ic.min_academic_year, ic.avg_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.FIRST_DAY_OF_CLASSES FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS at ON ic.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.TERM_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH enrolled_variance_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, VARIANCE(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_students_variance FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, enrolled_students_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE enrolled_students_variance > (SELECT AVG(enrolled_students_variance) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY enrolled_students_variance DESC), material_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS AS material_status_description, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS` AS tms ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON td.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND td.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE (NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY NOT LIKE 'N/ACourse has no materials%') GROUP BY tms.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(material_count) AS highest_material_count_for_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, evc.enrolled_students_variance, mcc.highest_material_count_for_status FROM enrolled_variance_cte AS evc LEFT JOIN material_count_cte AS mcc ON evc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY evc.enrolled_students_variance DESC

WITH MathTermStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), ChemistrySubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_num_enrolled_students FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, c.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, c.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SCHOOL_NAME, c.max_num_enrolled_students, m.min_academic_year, m.avg_total_units FROM ChemistrySubjectStats AS c JOIN MathTermStats AS m ON c.TERM_CODE = m.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.TERM_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department,
    tso.SUBJECT_ID,
    tso.SUBJECT_TITLE,
    tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
    tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME,
    scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso
  JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON tso.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE
  WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%'
    AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Mathematics', 'Chemistry')
    AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL
),
dept_max AS (
  SELECT 
    department, 
    MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled,
    MAX(CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(b2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM base AS b2 WHERE b2.department = base.department) THEN RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME END) AS faculty_for_max,
    MAX(CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(b2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM base AS b2 WHERE b2.department = base.department) THEN SUBJECT_TITLE END) AS subject_with_max
  FROM base
  GROUP BY department
),
avg_enrollment AS (
  SELECT 
    department, 
    AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled
  FROM base
  GROUP BY department
),
degree_granting_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    department, 
    AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_degree_granting,
    VARIANCE(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS variance_degree_granting
  FROM base
  WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND department <> 'Political Science'
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT 
  me.department,
  me.max_enrolled,
  me.faculty_for_max,
  ae.avg_enrolled AS avg_enrolled_if_max_gt_5,
  dgs.avg_degree_granting,
  dgs.variance_degree_granting,
  me.subject_with_max,
  me.max_enrolled AS students_in_max_subject
FROM dept_max AS me
JOIN avg_enrollment AS ae ON me.department = ae.department
LEFT JOIN degree_granting_stats AS dgs ON me.department = dgs.department
WHERE me.max_enrolled > 5
ORDER BY me.department

    MASTER_SUBJECT_ID,
    SUBJECT_TITLE,

  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED
  WHERE TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%'
    AND COURSE_NUMBER IN ('18','5')
    AND NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS IS NOT NULL
),
dept_max AS (
  SELECT COURSE_NUMBER, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enr
  FROM base
  GROUP BY COURSE_NUMBER
),
max_fac AS (
  SELECT b.COURSE_NUMBER, b.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
  FROM base b
  JOIN dept_max d ON b.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE_NUMBER AND b.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = d.max_enr
  ORDER BY b.COURSE_NUMBER, b.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME
  LIMIT 1
),
dept_avg AS (
  SELECT b.COURSE_NUMBER, AVG(b.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enr
  FROM base b
  JOIN dept_max d ON b.COURSE_NUMBER = d.COURSE_NUMBER
  WHERE d.max_enr > 5
  GROUP BY b.COURSE_NUMBER
),
deg AS (
  SELECT
    b.COURSE_NUMBER,
    AVG(b.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS deg_avg,
    VAR_SAMP(b.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS deg_var
  FROM base b
  JOIN SUBJECT_ENROLLABLE e
    ON b.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID = e.MASTER_SUBJECT_ID
   AND b.COURSE_NUMBER = e.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  WHERE b.COURSE_NUMBER <> '5'
  GROUP BY b.COURSE_NUMBER
),
top AS (
  SELECT b.COURSE_NUMBER, b.SUBJECT_TITLE, b.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS
  FROM base b
  ORDER BY b.COURSE_NUMBER, b.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, b.SUBJECT_TITLE
  LIMIT 1
)

  d.COURSE_NUMBER AS department,
